language_content: {"en": {"stem": "A solid uniform cylinder of mass M and radius R is projected with initial linear velocity v0 and zero angular velocity along a horizontal surface with coefficient of kinetic friction mu. After what time t does the cylinder begin pure rolling without slipping?", "options": {"A": "t = v0 / (3 mu g)", "B": "t = 2 v0 / (3 mu g)", "C": "t = v0 / (2 mu g)", "D": "t = 2 v0 / (5 mu g)"}, "solution": "Kinetic friction force f_k = mu M g opposes motion: v(t) = v0 - mu g t. Friction exerts torque tau = f_k R = I alpha => (1/2 M R^2) alpha = mu M g R => alpha = 2 mu g / R. Angular velocity omega(t) = alpha t = (2 mu g t) / R. Pure rolling occurs when v(t) = R omega(t) => v0 - mu g t = 2 mu g t => 3 mu g t = v0 => t = v0 / (3 mu g)."}, "hi": {"stem": "द्रव्यमान M और त्रिज्या R का एक ठोस बेलन गतिज घर्षण गुणांक mu वाली एक क्षैतिज सतह पर प्रारंभिक रेखीय वेग v0 और शून्य कोणीय वेग के साथ प्रक्षेपित किया जाता है। कितने समय t के पश्चात बेलन बिना फिसले शुद्ध लोटनिक गति प्रारंभ करेगा?", "options": {"A": "t = v0 / (3 mu g)", "B": "t = 2 v0 / (3 mu g)", "C": "t = v0 / (2 mu g)", "D": "t = 2 v0 / (5 mu g)"}, "solution": "गतिज घर्षण बल f_k = mu M g के कारण मंदन a = mu g और कोणीय त्वरण alpha = 2 mu g / R होता है। शुद्ध लोटनिक गति हेतु v = R omega => v0 - mu g t = 2 mu g t => t = v0 / (3 mu g) प्राप्त होता है।"}}

{"en": {"stem": "A photon of initial wavelength lambda undergoes Compton scattering through an angle theta = 90 degrees with an electron initially at rest (Compton wavelength of electron lambda_C = h / (m_e c)). What is the wavelength shift Delta lambda?", "options": {"A": "Delta lambda = 2 lambda_C", "B": "Delta lambda = lambda_C", "C": "Delta lambda = lambda_C / 2", "D": "Delta lambda = sqrt(2) lambda_C"}, "solution": "The Compton scattering formula is Delta lambda = lambda' - lambda = (h / (m_e c)) * (1 - cos theta). For theta = 90 degrees, cos(90) = 0, so Delta lambda = lambda_C * (1 - 0) = lambda_C."}, "hi": {"stem": "प्रारंभिक तरंगदैर्ध्य लैम्ब्डा का एक फोटॉन विराम में स्थित इलेक्ट्रॉन के साथ कोण थीटा = 90 अंश पर कॉम्पटन प्रकीर्णन करता है (इलेक्ट्रॉन की कॉम्पटन तरंगदैर्ध्य lambda_C = h / (m_e c))। तरंगदैर्ध्य विस्थापन Delta lambda क्या है?", "options": {"A": "Delta lambda = 2 lambda_C", "B": "Delta lambda = lambda_C", "C": "Delta lambda = lambda_C / 2", "D": "Delta lambda = sqrt(2) lambda_C"}, "solution": "कॉम्पटन प्रकीर्णन सूत्र Delta lambda = (h / (m_e c)) * (1 - cos theta) होता है। theta = 90 अंश पर cos(90) = 0 होने से Delta lambda = lambda_C प्राप्त होता है।"}}

{"en": {"stem": "A vertical glass capillary tube of radius r is dipped into a liquid of surface tension T, density rho, and contact angle theta. What is the equilibrium height h of the liquid column raised in the capillary tube?", "options": {"A": "h = (T cos theta) / (2 r rho g)", "B": "h = (T sin theta) / (r rho g)", "C": "h = (2 T cos theta) / (r rho g)", "D": "h = (4 T cos theta) / (r rho g)"}, "solution": "Balancing vertical surface tension force and weight of liquid column: 2 pi r T cos theta = (pi r^2 h rho) g => h = (2 T cos theta) / (r rho g)."}, "hi": {"stem": "त्रिज्या r की एक ऊर्ध्वाधर कांच की केशनली को पृष्ठ तनाव T, घनत्व rho और स्पर्श कोण थीटा वाले द्रव में डुबोया जाता है। केशनली में चढ़े द्रव स्तंभ की संतुलन ऊंचाई h क्या है?", "options": {"A": "h = (T cos theta) / (2 r rho g)", "B": "h = (T sin theta) / (r rho g)", "C": "h = (2 T cos theta) / (r rho g)", "D": "h = (4 T cos theta) / (r rho g)"}, "solution": "पृष्ठ तनाव के ऊर्ध्वाधर घटक और द्रव स्तंभ के भार का संतुलन: 2 pi r T cos theta = pi r^2 h rho g => h = (2 T cos theta) / (r rho g)।"}}

{"en": {"stem": "A circular parallel-plate capacitor with plate radius R is being charged such that the electric field between plates increases at a constant rate dE/dt. What is the induced magnetic field B at a radial distance r (r < R) from the central axis?", "options": {"A": "B = (mu0 epsilon0 r^2 / (2 R)) dE/dt", "B": "B = (mu0 epsilon0 R / 2) dE/dt", "C": "B = mu0 epsilon0 r dE/dt", "D": "B = (mu0 epsilon0 r / 2) dE/dt"}, "solution": "By the Maxwell-Ampere law: oint B . dl = mu0 epsilon0 (d Phi_E / dt). For a circle of radius r < R, Phi_E = E * pi r^2, so B * 2 pi r = mu0 epsilon0 pi r^2 (dE/dt) => B = (mu0 epsilon0 r / 2) dE/dt."}, "hi": {"stem": "प्लेट त्रिज्या R वाले एक वृत्ताकार समांतर पट्टिका संधारित्र को इस प्रकार आवेशित किया जा रहा है कि प्लेटों के मध्य विद्युत क्षेत्र dE/dt की नियत दर से बढ़ता है। केंद्रीय अक्ष से त्रिज्यीय दूरी r (r < R) पर प्रेरित चुंबकीय क्षेत्र B क्या है?", "options": {"A": "B = (mu0 epsilon0 r^2 / (2 R)) dE/dt", "B": "B = (mu0 epsilon0 R / 2) dE/dt", "C": "B = mu0 epsilon0 r dE/dt", "D": "B = (mu0 epsilon0 r / 2) dE/dt"}, "solution": "मैक्सवेल-एम्पीयर नियम अनुसार: oint B . dl = mu0 epsilon0 (d Phi_E / dt)। त्रिज्या r के वृत्ताकार लूप हेतु B * 2 pi r = mu0 epsilon0 pi r^2 (dE/dt) => B = (mu0 epsilon0 r / 2) dE/dt प्राप्त होता है।"}}

{"en": {"stem": "For a real gas obeying the Van der Waals equation of state (P + a/V^2)(V - b) = R T, what is the maximum Joule-Thomson inversion temperature T_i above which the gas undergoes heating on adiabatic expansion?", "options": {"A": "T_i = (2 a) / (R b)", "B": "T_i = a / (R b)", "C": "T_i = (8 a) / (27 R b)", "D": "T_i = a / (2 R b)"}, "solution": "The Joule-Thomson coefficient mu_JT = 0 defines the inversion temperature: (partial H / partial P)_T = 0. In the low pressure limit for a Van der Waals gas, T_i = (2 a) / (R b). Above T_i, mu_JT < 0 and expansion causes heating."}, "hi": {"stem": "वान्डर वाल्स समीकरण (P + a/V^2)(V - b) = R T का पालन करने वाली वास्तविक गैस के लिए, अधिकतम जूल-थॉमसन व्युत्क्रमण ताप T_i क्या है जिसके ऊपर रुद्धोष्म प्रसार पर गैस गर्म होती है?", "options": {"A": "T_i = (2 a) / (R b)", "B": "T_i = a / (R b)", "C": "T_i = (8 a) / (27 R b)", "D": "T_i = a / (2 R b)"}, "solution": "जूल-थॉमसन व्युत्क्रमण ताप की शर्त mu_JT = 0 होती है। वान्डर वाल्स गैस हेतु निम्न दाब सीमा में व्युत्क्रमण ताप T_i = (2 a) / (R b) होता है। इसके ऊपर प्रसार करने पर गैस गर्म होती है।"}}

{"en": {"stem": "In Fraunhofer single-slit diffraction with slit width a illuminated normally by light of wavelength lambda, what is the angular width (in radians) of the central diffraction maximum between the first diffraction minima on either side?", "options": {"A": "theta = lambda / a", "B": "theta = (2 lambda) / a", "C": "theta = (3 lambda) / (2 a)", "D": "theta = (4 lambda) / a"}, "solution": "The first minima occur at angles sin theta = +- lambda / a => theta1 = +- lambda / a (for small angles). The total angular width of the central maximum is 2 theta1 = (2 lambda) / a."}, "hi": {"stem": "तरंगदैर्ध्य लैम्ब्डा के प्रकाश द्वारा लंबवत प्रकाशित झिरी चौड़ाई a के फ्राउनहोफर एकल-झिरी विवर्तन में, दोनों ओर के प्रथम विवर्तन निम्निष्ठों के मध्य केंद्रीय विवर्तन उच्चिष्ठ की कोणीय चौड़ाई (रेडियन में) क्या है?", "options": {"A": "theta = lambda / a", "B": "theta = (2 lambda) / a", "C": "theta = (3 lambda) / (2 a)", "D": "theta = (4 lambda) / a"}, "solution": "प्रथम निम्निष्ठ sin theta = +- lambda / a पर बनते हैं। अतः केंद्रीय उच्चिष्ठ की कुल कोणीय चौड़ाई 2 theta = 2 lambda / a होती है।"}}

{"en": {"stem": "A uniform thin rod of length L oscillates as a compound pendulum about a horizontal axis perpendicular to the rod. At what distance x from the center of mass must the suspension point be located to achieve the minimum possible time period of oscillation?", "options": {"A": "x = L / 2", "B": "x = L / 4", "C": "x = L / (2 sqrt(3))", "D": "x = L / sqrt(6)"}, "solution": "Time period of compound pendulum T = 2 pi sqrt((k^2/x + x) / g). T is minimum when x = k (radius of gyration about CM). For a thin rod, k = sqrt(I_cm / M) = sqrt((M L^2 / 12) / M) = L / (2 sqrt(3))."}, "hi": {"stem": "लंबाई L की एकसमान पतली छड़ छड़ के लंबवत एक क्षैतिज अक्ष के परितः यौगिक लोलक के रूप में दोलन करती है। दोलन का न्यूनतम संभव आवर्तकाल प्राप्त करने हेतु निलंबन बिंदु द्रव्यमान केंद्र से कितनी दूरी x पर होना चाहिए?", "options": {"A": "x = L / 2", "B": "x = L / 4", "C": "x = L / (2 sqrt(3))", "D": "x = L / sqrt(6)"}, "solution": "यौगिक लोलक का आवर्तकाल न्यूनतम तब होता है जब x = k (घूर्णन त्रिज्या) हो। पतली छड़ हेतु k = L / (2 sqrt(3)) होता है, अतः x = L / (2 sqrt(3)) पर न्यूनतम आवर्तकाल मिलता है।"}}

{"en": {"stem": "In an alpha decay of a stationary parent nucleus of mass number A into a daughter nucleus and an alpha particle, what fraction of the total disintegration energy Q is carried away as kinetic energy of the alpha particle?", "options": {"A": "K_alpha / Q = 4 / A", "B": "K_alpha / Q = (A - 2) / A", "C": "K_alpha / Q = A / (A - 4)", "D": "K_alpha / Q = (A - 4) / A"}, "solution": "By linear momentum conservation, p_alpha = p_D. Kinetic energy K = p^2 / (2 m). Therefore K_alpha / K_D = m_D / m_alpha = (A - 4) / 4. Total Q = K_alpha + K_D = K_alpha (1 + 4 / (A - 4)) = K_alpha (A / (A - 4)) => K_alpha / Q = (A - 4) / A."}, "hi": {"stem": "द्रव्यमान संख्या A वाले एक स्थिर मूल नाभिक के एक संतति नाभिक और एक अल्फा कण में अल्फा क्षय में, कुल विघटन ऊर्जा Q का कौन-सा अंश अल्फा कण की गतिज ऊर्जा के रूप में ले जाया जाता है?", "options": {"A": "K_alpha / Q = 4 / A", "B": "K_alpha / Q = (A - 2) / A", "C": "K_alpha / Q = A / (A - 4)", "D": "K_alpha / Q = (A - 4) / A"}, "solution": "संवेग संरक्षण से p_alpha = p_D होता है। गतिज ऊर्जा K = p^2 / (2 m) होने के कारण K_alpha = Q * (A - 4) / A प्राप्त होता है।"}}

{"en": {"stem": "A point charge +q is located at distance d from an infinite grounded conducting plane (z = 0). What is the magnitude of the attractive force exerted by the induced surface charges on the conducting plane upon the point charge +q?", "options": {"A": "F = q^2 / (16 pi epsilon0 d^2)", "B": "F = q^2 / (4 pi epsilon0 d^2)", "C": "F = q^2 / (8 pi epsilon0 d^2)", "D": "F = q^2 / (2 pi epsilon0 d^2)"}, "solution": "Using the method of images, the grounded conducting plane is replaced by an image charge -q at distance d behind the plane (total separation 2 d). The force is F = (1 / (4 pi epsilon0)) * (q * q) / (2 d)^2 = q^2 / (16 pi epsilon0 d^2)."}, "hi": {"stem": "एक बिंदु आवेश +q एक अनंत भू-संपर्कित चालक तल (z = 0) से दूरी d पर स्थित है। चालक तल पर प्रेरित पृष्ठीय आवेशों द्वारा बिंदु आवेश +q पर आरोपित आकर्षण बल का परिमाण क्या है?", "options": {"A": "F = q^2 / (16 pi epsilon0 d^2)", "B": "F = q^2 / (4 pi epsilon0 d^2)", "C": "F = q^2 / (8 pi epsilon0 d^2)", "D": "F = q^2 / (2 pi epsilon0 d^2)"}, "solution": "प्रतिबिंब विधि द्वारा चालक तल को 2 d की दूरी पर स्थित -q प्रतिबिंब आवेश द्वारा प्रतिस्थापित किया जाता है। अतः F = q^2 / (4 pi epsilon0 (2 d)^2) = q^2 / (16 pi epsilon0 d^2) होता है।"}}

{"en": {"stem": "In an LCR series resonant circuit with inductance L, capacitance C, and resistance R, what is the expression for the quality factor Q at resonance frequency omega0?", "options": {"A": "Q = R * sqrt(C / L)", "B": "Q = (1 / R) * sqrt(L / C)", "C": "Q = (1 / R) * sqrt(C / L)", "D": "Q = R * sqrt(L / C)"}, "solution": "Quality factor Q = (omega0 * L) / R. Since omega0 = 1 / sqrt(L * C), we get Q = (1 / (R * sqrt(L C))) * L = (1 / R) * sqrt(L / C)."}, "hi": {"stem": "प्रेरकत्व L, धारिता C और प्रतिरोध R वाले एक LCR श्रेणी अनुनादी परिपथ में, अनुनादी आवृत्ति omega0 पर गुणवत्ता कारक (Q-फैक्टर) का व्यंजक क्या है?", "options": {"A": "Q = R * sqrt(C / L)", "B": "Q = (1 / R) * sqrt(L / C)", "C": "Q = (1 / R) * sqrt(C / L)", "D": "Q = R * sqrt(L / C)"}, "solution": "अनुनादी परिपथ में Q = omega0 L / R होता है। चूँकि omega0 = 1 / sqrt(L C), अतः Q = (1 / R) * sqrt(L / C) प्राप्त होता है।"}}

{"en": {"stem": "A steady current I flows through a planar wire bent in the shape of a regular polygon of n sides inscribed in a circle of radius R. What is the magnetic field intensity B at the center of the polygon?", "options": {"A": "B = (mu0 n I / (2 pi R)) * sin(pi / n)", "B": "B = (mu0 n I / (4 pi R)) * cos(pi / n)", "C": "B = (mu0 n I / (2 pi R)) * tan(pi / n)", "D": "B = (mu0 n I / (pi R)) * tan(pi / n)"}, "solution": "The distance of each side from center is d = R cos(pi / n), and each side subtends angle 2 pi / n (half angle alpha = pi / n). For each side, B1 = (mu0 I / (4 pi d)) * (sin alpha + sin alpha) = (mu0 I / (2 pi R cos(pi/n))) * sin(pi/n) = (mu0 I / (2 pi R)) tan(pi/n). For n sides, B = (mu0 n I / (2 pi R)) * tan(pi / n)."}, "hi": {"stem": "त्रिज्या R के एक वृत्त में अंतर्निहित n भुजाओं वाले एक समबहुभुज के आकार में मुड़े तार में एक स्थिर धारा I प्रवाहित होती है। बहुभुज के केंद्र पर चुंबकीय क्षेत्र तीव्रता B क्या है?", "options": {"A": "B = (mu0 n I / (2 pi R)) * sin(pi / n)", "B": "B = (mu0 n I / (4 pi R)) * cos(pi / n)", "C": "B = (mu0 n I / (2 pi R)) * tan(pi / n)", "D": "B = (mu0 n I / (pi R)) * tan(pi / n)"}, "solution": "प्रत्येक भुजा के लिए केंद्र पर चुंबकीय क्षेत्र B1 = (mu0 I / (2 pi R)) tan(pi/n) होता है। n भुजाओं हेतु कुल क्षेत्र B = (mu0 n I / (2 pi R)) * tan(pi / n) होता है।"}}

{"en": {"stem": "When unpolarized light in air strikes a dielectric medium of refractive index mu at the Brewster angle i_B, which of the following statements is strictly correct regarding the reflected and refracted rays?", "options": {"A": "Both reflected and refracted rays are completely linearly polarized", "B": "The reflected ray is circularly polarized and perpendicular to refracted ray", "C": "The refracted ray is completely polarized parallel to the incident plane", "D": "The reflected ray is completely linearly polarized and perpendicular to the refracted ray"}, "solution": "At Brewster angle tan(i_B) = mu, the reflected ray is completely linearly polarized with vibrations perpendicular to the plane of incidence, and the reflected and refracted rays are mutually perpendicular (i_B + r = 90 degrees)."}, "hi": {"stem": "जब वायु में अध्रुवित प्रकाश ब्रूस्टर कोण i_B पर अपवर्तनांक mu वाले परावैद्युत माध्यम से टकराता है, तो परावर्तित और अपवर्तित किरणों के संबंध में कौन-सा कथन पूर्णतः सत्य है?", "options": {"A": "Both reflected and refracted rays are completely linearly polarized", "B": "The reflected ray is circularly polarized and perpendicular to refracted ray", "C": "The refracted ray is completely polarized parallel to the incident plane", "D": "The reflected ray is completely linearly polarized and perpendicular to the refracted ray"}, "solution": "ब्रूस्टर कोण tan(i_B) = mu पर परावर्तित किरण आपतन तल के लंबवत पूर्णतः रेखीय ध्रुवित होती है तथा परावर्तित एवं अपवर्तित किरणें परस्पर लंबवत (90 अंश) होती हैं।"}}

{"en": {"stem": "A rocket of initial total mass M0 expels propellant exhaust gases at a constant relative velocity u_rel. Neglecting external gravity and atmospheric drag, what is the speed v of the rocket when its mass decreases to M?", "options": {"A": "v = u_rel * ln(M0 / M)", "B": "v = u_rel * (M0 - M) / M", "C": "v = u_rel * ln(M / M0)", "D": "v = (1/2) u_rel * (M0 / M)^2"}, "solution": "By Tsiolkovsky rocket equation: M (dv/dt) = - u_rel (dM/dt) => dv = - u_rel (dM / M). Integrating from M0 to M gives v - 0 = - u_rel ln(M / M0) = u_rel ln(M0 / M)."}, "hi": {"stem": "प्रारंभिक कुल द्रव्यमान M0 का एक रॉकेट एक नियत आपेक्षिक वेग u_rel पर प्रणोदक निकास गैसों का निष्कासन करता है। बाह्य गुरुत्वाकर्षण और वायुमंडलीय घर्षण को नगण्य मानते हुए, जब इसका द्रव्यमान घटकर M हो जाता है तो रॉकेट की चाल v क्या होगी?", "options": {"A": "v = u_rel * ln(M0 / M)", "B": "v = u_rel * (M0 - M) / M", "C": "v = u_rel * ln(M / M0)", "D": "v = (1/2) u_rel * (M0 / M)^2"}, "solution": "त्सियोलकोव्स्की रॉकेट समीकरण: M dv = - u_rel dM => समाकलन करने पर v = u_rel * ln(M0 / M) प्राप्त होता है।"}}

{"en": {"stem": "A damped harmonic oscillator of mass m, spring constant k, and damping constant b undergoes underdamped oscillations with angular frequency omega'. What is the logarithmic decrement delta between successive peak amplitudes x_n and x_{n+1} separated by time period T'?", "options": {"A": "delta = b / (2 m)", "B": "delta = (b T') / (2 m)", "C": "delta = (b T') / m", "D": "delta = 2 m / (b T')"}, "solution": "Amplitude decays as A(t) = A0 exp(- b t / (2 m)). {"en": {"stem": "In the Lindemann-Hinshelwood unimolecular reaction mechanism: A + A <=>[k1][k-1] A* + A (activation/deactivation), followed by A* ->[k2] Products (decomposition). {"en": {"stem": "According to VSEPR theory, what is the geometric molecular shape and the number of non-bonding lone pairs of electrons located on the central xenon atom in xenon tetrafluoride (XeF4)?", "options": {"A": "Tetrahedral geometry with zero lone pairs", "B": "See-saw geometry with one lone pair", "C": "Square planar geometry with two trans lone pairs", "D": "T-shaped geometry with three lone pairs"}, "solution": "Xe has 8 valence electrons. {"en": {"stem": "Which of the following formulations correctly expresses the Gibbs-Helmholtz thermodynamic equation relating Gibbs free energy G to enthalpy H at constant pressure?", "options": {"A": "[partial (Delta G / T) / partial T]_P = - Delta H / T^2", "B": "[partial (Delta G / T) / partial T]_P = Delta H / T", "C": "[partial (Delta G) / partial T]_P = Delta H / T^2", "D": "[partial (Delta G / T) / partial P]_T = - Delta H / T^2"}, "solution": "From G = H - TS => G/T = H/T - S. {"en": {"stem": "According to Nernst Heat Theorem and Planck's formulation of the Third Law of Thermodynamics, what is the absolute entropy S of a perfectly crystalline pure substance at absolute zero temperature (0 K)?", "options": {"A": "S -> infinity", "B": "S = 0 J / (mol K)", "C": "S = R ln(2)", "D": "S = - 273.15 J / (mol K)"}, "solution": "The Third Law states that the entropy of a perfectly crystalline substance approaches zero as temperature approaches absolute zero: lim_{T->0} S = 0, because there is only one microstate (W = 1, S = k_B ln(W) = 0)."}, "hi": {"stem": "नेर्न्स्ट ऊष्मा प्रमेय और प्लांक के ऊष्मागतिकी के तृतीय नियम के अनुसार, परम शून्य ताप (0 K) पर पूर्णतः क्रिस्टलीय शुद्ध पदार्थ की परम एन्ट्रॉपी S क्या होती है?", "options": {"A": "S -> infinity", "B": "S = 0 J / (mol K)", "C": "S = R ln(2)", "D": "S = - 273.15 J / (mol K)"}, "solution": "ऊष्मागतिकी के तृतीय नियम के अनुसार परम शून्य ताप (0 K) पर शुद्ध क्रिस्टलीय पदार्थ की एन्ट्रॉपी शून्य होती है (S = k_B ln(1) = 0)।"}}

{"en": {"stem": "The carbylamine test involves heating an organic compound with chloroform (CHCl3) and ethanolic potassium hydroxide (KOH) to produce an extremely foul-smelling isocyanide.
